LESSON: WRITING 5.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING: CREATIVE LANGUAGE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we develop good handwriting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify aspects of creative language in texts based on the theme for fluency
2. write texts based on the theme neatly and legibly for effective communication
3. appreciate creativity and handwriting in effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 5.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING: CREATIVE LANGUAGE
This lesson teaches Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language for Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify aspects of creative language in texts based on the theme for fluency
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write texts based on the theme neatly and legibly for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate creativity and handwriting in effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language above.
2. Explain Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing: Creative language important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we develop good handwriting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify aspects of creative language in texts based on the theme for fluency
2. write texts based on the theme neatly and legibly for effective communication
3. appreciate creativity and handwriting in effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
